2608.22559.title: ExecRubrics: Executable Tool-Augmented Rubrics for Verifiable and Efficient Long-Form Evaluation
2608.22559.paper_summary: Rubrics aim to make language-model evaluation transparent by decomposing response quality into interpretable criteria. However, natural-language rubrics are often ambiguous, require LLM judges, and typically assume criteria aggregated through linear weighted sums, limiting their ability to capture dependencies, alternatives, penalties, and override conditions. We propose ExecRubrics, a framework for representing rubrics as compact executable programs. ExecRubrics encodes evaluation logic as verifiable Python scoring functions, giving natural-language rubric intent an operational semantics: a fixed decision procedure that can be inspected, executed, and edited. On three long-form response benchmarks -- HealthBench, HelpSteer, and ArgQuality -- we show that ExecRubrics can recover substantial preference signal without an LLM judge at evaluation time. On ArgQuality and HelpSteer, the strongest executable variants are within 1.1 and 4 percentage points, respectively, of the direct GPT-5.5 agentic baseline. Executable rubrics are also considerably faster, achieving a 192x average speedup. We show that incorporating external logic and resources from text processing libraries such as NLTK and spaCy can further improve preference accuracy. Our results suggest a novel way of approaching automated evaluation, by offering a faster, more explainable, and less ambiguous alternative to black-box rubric evals, particularly in high-stakes domains such as healthcare and banking where precision and auditability are critical.
2608.22559.paper_summary_zh: 評分標準旨在通過將回應質量分解為可解釋的標準，使語言模型評估變得透明。然而，自然語言評分標準往往模糊不清，需要 LLM 評審，並且通常假設通過線性加權總和來聚合標準，這限制了它們捕捉依賴關係、替代方案、懲罰和覆蓋條件的能力。我們提出 ExecRubrics，一個將評分標準表示為緊湊可執行程序的框架。ExecRubrics 將評估邏輯編碼為可驗證的 Python 計分函數，賦予自然語言評分標準意圖一個操作語義：一個固定的決策程序，可以被檢查、執行和編輯。在三個長篇回應基準上——HealthBench、HelpSteer 和 ArgQuality——我們展示了 ExecRubrics 可以在評估時恢復可觀的偏好信號，而不需要 LLM 評審。在 ArgQuality 和 HelpSteer 上，最強的可執行變體分別與直接的 GPT-5.5 代理基準相差 1.1 和 4 個百分點。可執行評分標準的速度也顯著更快，實現了平均 192 倍的加速。我們展示了從文本處理庫（如 NLTK 和 spaCy）中整合外部邏輯和資源可以進一步提高偏好準確性。我們的結果表明了一種新穎的自動化評估方法，通過提供一種更快、更可解釋且不那麼模糊的替代方案來取代黑箱評分標準評估，特別是在醫療和銀行等高風險領域，在這些領域中，精確性和可審計性至關重要。
